steps.caption: Option 4B · Review mode. A report opens full width, with the brief folded to one line.
Review mode: a 72-character column, the notes margin kept, a bar at the bottom for Send, Accept and Done.
Changes shows what moved since the first draft: removed lines struck through, added words tinted.
Select words in the report and the bar offers Keep, Change and Ask: a ticked note in one press.
Done brings the task back, scrolled to that report.
